_comment: The one source of truth for the facts in Lumi's legal texts. packaging/legal_texts.py renders lumi/legal/templates/ with these values into lumi/legal/*.md, sdk/LICENSE, sdk/python/lumi_extension/LICENSE and lumi/code_editors/vscode/LICENSE.txt, and the installers' license pages. A value still reading [[TO BE PROVIDED: ...]] warns in pull request CI and fails a release build (RELEASING.md). Each document's sha256 pins the text of its version: any change to what a text says needs a new version and a new pin, or tests/test_legal_texts.py and the release check fail. A new version of the EULA, or of the Alpha and Beta Test Terms on a pre-release build, asks everyone to accept it again (lumi/terms.py), as does an accepted text that no longer matches its pin; a new version of the privacy notice or of the SDK license asks no one. published is the day a version's text was written: each version applies to a person from the day they accept it, and a release build refuses a published date after its own.

alpha_terms.title: Lumi Alpha and Beta Test Terms
